patch_description: This candidate builds on the strongest prior architecture, retaining its low generalization gap, complete interaction graph, disjoint CZ scheduling, and regularizing parameter ties. It selectively unties the final RY rotations on core qubits 2 and 3, adding only one independent parameter per repeated block while allowing the output basis to distinguish these central nodes. This targeted capacity increase should improve validation fit and loss more efficiently than broadly untying the circuit.
